name: Thrombocytopenia with Congenital Dyserythropoietic Anemia
aliases: Congenital dyserythropoietic anemia type with thrombocytopenia

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic criteria for Thrombocytopenia with Congenital Dyserythropoietic Anemia

criteria.description: Presence of congenital dyserythropoiesis confirmed by bone marrow examination showing multinuclear erythroblasts and abnormal erythroid precursors
Persistent thrombocytopenia documented by platelet counts below normal reference range without evidence of immune-mediated destruction
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes associated with CDA and thrombocytopenia (e.g., KIF23 mutations)
Evidence of hemolytic anemia with elevated reticulocyte count and indirect hyperbilirubinemia
Exclusion of immune thrombocytopenic purpura and other acquired causes of thrombocytopenia

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: All three major criteria (dyserythropoiesis on marrow exam, persistent thrombocytopenia, and genetic confirmation) must be met
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of acquired causes of anemia and thrombocytopenia

pathognomonic.symptomName: Abnormality of multiple cell lineages in the bone marrow

laboratory: Peripheral blood smear showing anisopoikilocytosis and thrombocytopenia
Bone marrow biopsy revealing multinuclear erythroblasts and dyserythropoiesis
Elevated lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) and indirect bilirubin indicating hemolysis
imaging: Ultrasound showing splenomegaly and occasional hepatomegaly
Chest X-ray may reveal cardiomegaly in chronic severe anemia
other: Exclusion of immune thrombocytopenic purpura by negative platelet antibody testing

distinguishingFeatures: Absence of dyserythropoiesis on bone marrow examination

redFlags: Progressive anemia refractory to supportive care
Signs of bone marrow failure or transformation
references: Bain BJ. Congenital dyserythropoietic anemias. Haematologica. 2006;91(4):482-6.
Orphanet: Thrombocytopenia with congenital dyserythropoietic anemia. ORPHA:67044.
